LanguageData.VREH_GeneticDrugNeed_Luci.description: This person has a genetically-induced biochemical dependency on a specific drug. Without regular doses of the drug, their body cannot maintain itself in a healthy state and they will suffer degrading health and mood until they die.\n\nTakes effect after age: 13.
LanguageData.VREH_GeneticDrugNeed_Luci.label: chemical dependency
LanguageData.VREH_GeneticDrugNeed_Luci.stages.1.label: deficiency
LanguageData.VREH_Glidewings.description: A small set of wings growing from this person's shoulderblades. They are not capable of flight, but they will not be slowed down by any obstacles.
LanguageData.VREH_Glidewings.label: glidewings
